statement: Copy must sound warm and confident, like a friendly barista who knows the beans.
source_quote: Our voice is warm and confident, like a friendly barista who knows the beans.
examples_violating: Coffee is coffee. Whatever, just buy it.
We guess this might maybe be an okay roast?
examples_ok: Come in, the first pour of the morning is on its way.
We roast every Tuesday and Friday, so your bag is always fresh.

statement: Never push, pressure or guilt readers into buying.
source_quote: Never push, pressure or guilt a reader into buying.
examples_violating: Still no coffee in your cart? Stop wasting time and order now.
Real coffee lovers would not skip this. Buy it today.
examples_ok: Our new roast is here whenever you are ready.
Try a cup in the cafe and tell us what you think.

statement: No sarcasm, and never mock customers, other cafes or coffee habits.
source_quote: Never use sarcasm or mock our customers, other cafes or coffee habits.
examples_violating: Oh sure, instant coffee is totally a personality.
Another Monday, another 'brilliant' idea: skipping breakfast.
examples_ok: Monday mornings are better with a slow pour.
Whatever your brew method, we are happy to help you refine it.

statement: At most one exclamation mark per post; no ALL CAPS words.
source_quote: Use at most one exclamation mark per post and avoid words in ALL CAPS.
examples_violating: FRESH ROAST is HERE!!! Come NOW!
Wow! Amazing! Brew time!
examples_ok: Fresh roast is here. Come in for a cup!
New batch, roasted this Tuesday.

statement: Avoid inappropriate humour.
source_quote: Avoid inappropriate humour.
examples_violating: Our espresso is so strong it will fix your ex problem.
Decaf is for people who fear commitment.
examples_ok: Our cold brew is so smooth, even Mondays calm down.
A good morning starts with a good pour.

statement: Posts should feel premium.
source_quote: Posts should feel premium.
examples_violating: Coffee beans on sale, grab a bag, whatever you like.
Lol our coffee is lit, come get it.
examples_ok: Small-batch beans from Chikmagalur, roasted in Pune this week.
A slow, unhurried pour. Welcome.

statement: Keep everything we publish on-brand.
source_quote: Keep it on-brand.
examples_violating: Cheap beans, big discount, buy buy buy!
Meme of a dancing cat with our logo stuck on top.
examples_ok: A calm cafe morning with the steam rising from a fresh cup.
Meet the grower behind this month's Chikmagalur lot.

statement: The old product name 'Steam Classic' must always be written 'Saffron Signature Roast'.
source_quote: Our old product name Steam Classic is retired; always write Saffron Signature Roast.
examples_violating: Try our Steam Classic this weekend.
Steam Classic 250g now in stores.
examples_ok: Try our Saffron Signature Roast this weekend.
Saffron Signature Roast 250g now in stores.

statement: Banned words: cheap, guaranteed, miracle, unbeatable, bargain.
source_quote: Never use the words cheap, guaranteed, miracle, unbeatable or bargain.
examples_violating: A cheap and guaranteed great morning.
An unbeatable bargain on beans.
examples_ok: Fairly priced beans for a great morning.
A well-loved roast at Rs 495.

statement: Write the brand name correctly: 'Saffron & Steam Coffee Co.' or 'Saffron & Steam'; never 'S&S' or 'saffron and steam'.
source_quote: Write the brand name as Saffron & Steam Coffee Co. and never as S&S or saffron and steam.
examples_violating: Visit S&S this weekend.
saffron and steam has a new roast.
examples_ok: Visit Saffron & Steam this weekend.
Saffron & Steam Coffee Co. has a new roast.

statement: No superlatives or '#1' claims (best, number one, finest, India's favourite) without an approved, sourced fact.
source_quote: Do not call us the best, the number one or the finest unless an approved fact with a source proves it.
examples_violating: India's #1 coffee, hands down.
The best filter coffee in Pune.
examples_ok: Rated 4.6 on Google by 3,200 guests.
Our Saffron Signature Roast won Silver at a roasters' showcase in 2026.

statement: Every number, rating, award, price, offer and sourcing claim must match a current (not expired) approved fact.
source_quote: Every number, rating, award, price and sourcing claim must match a current approved fact.
examples_violating: Rated 4.8 stars by our customers.
We now have 40 cafes across India.
examples_ok: We have 12 cafes in Pune, Mumbai and Bengaluru.
Beans from 14 partner estates in Karnataka and Kerala.

statement: No organic, Fairtrade, sustainable or carbon-neutral claims; the brand holds no such certification.
source_quote: Do not call our coffee organic, Fairtrade, sustainable or carbon neutral; we hold no such certification.
examples_violating: 100% organic beans for a cleaner cup.
Our sustainable, carbon neutral roasting.
examples_ok: Our pouches are mono-material and recyclable.
We pay partner estates 18% above the local auction average.

statement: No fake urgency such as 'only today', 'last chance', 'hurry' or stacked exclamation marks.
source_quote: Do not invent urgency: no only today, last chance or hurry unless the offer really ends then.
examples_violating: Only today!!! Hurry before it is gone.
Last chance to grab your bag.
examples_ok: Our Diwali gift boxes are available till 15 November 2026.
New roast is in the cafes from Monday.

statement: Every promotion (discount, offer, code, free shipping) must state its end date.
source_quote: Every promotion must state its end date.
examples_violating: Flat 20% off with code MONSOON20.
Free shipping on all orders this season.
examples_ok: Flat 15% off gift boxes with DIWALI15, valid till 15 November 2026.
Free shipping above Rs 799, ends 30 November 2026.

statement: No health or medical claims (cure, treat, detox, weight loss, immunity, heart health, anxiety).
source_quote: Never make health or medical claims; coffee is a pleasure, not a treatment.
examples_violating: Our cold brew detoxes your body and helps you lose weight.
Drink two cups a day to boost immunity.
examples_ok: A slow pour to start your morning.
Roasted fresh, brewed with care.

statement: Giveaway, contest and lucky-draw posts must include the line 'T&C apply'.
source_quote: Every giveaway or contest post must carry the line T&C apply.
examples_violating: Win a free brew kit! Tag two friends to enter our giveaway.
Lucky draw this Sunday, everyone is eligible.
examples_ok: Tag two friends to enter our giveaway. T&C apply.
Join the contest by sharing your best brew photo. T&C apply.

statement: Prices must be in rupees, say taxes are included, and match the approved price (facts).
source_quote: Quote prices in rupees, say that taxes are included, and match the approved price list.
examples_violating: Saffron Signature Roast 250g for just Rs 399.
Gift box at 1,299 only.
examples_ok: Saffron Signature Roast 250g, Rs 495 incl. taxes.
Diwali gift box, Rs 1,299 incl. taxes.

statement: Use only the official logo file; never a redrawn, recoloured, stretched or retyped version.
source_quote: Always use the official logo file; never redraw, recolour, stretch or retype it.
examples_violating: An ad with a look-alike cup and a different typeface.
A stretched and recoloured logo.
examples_ok: An ad with the supplied logo.png at its original proportions.
A PDF with the logo placed from the official file.

statement: Keep clear space around the logo; no busy background behind it.
source_quote: Keep a clear space around the logo and never place it on a busy background.
examples_violating: Logo placed over a crowded street photo.
Logo touching the edge of a patterned banner.
examples_ok: Logo on a plain cream area with generous margin.
Logo on a flat saffron panel.

statement: Colours must come from the six-colour palette; no neon or off-palette colours.
source_quote: Use only the six palette colours; off-palette neon or gradients are not allowed.
examples_violating: Neon green background with magenta text.
A purple-to-pink gradient banner.
examples_ok: Cream background with deep coffee brown text and a saffron accent.
Cardamom green label on a cream pouch.

statement: PDF headings use Fraunces and body text uses Inter; no other typefaces.
source_quote: Set headings in Fraunces and body text in Inter; no other typefaces in PDFs.
examples_violating: A promo PDF set in Comic Sans.
A flyer in a decorative script font.
examples_ok: A promo PDF with Fraunces headings and Inter body.
A menu in Inter only.

statement: Imagery should feel authentic.
source_quote: Imagery should feel authentic.
examples_violating: Glossy over-edited stock photo of a model with a mug.
A cartoon filter over a cafe interior.
examples_ok: A real barista pouring at our Pune cafe.
Bags on a wooden counter in morning light.

statement: Every image must have alt text that describes what it shows.
source_quote: Every image needs alt text that describes what it shows.
examples_violating: An image post with no alt text.
Alt text that just says 'image'.
examples_ok: Alt: Barista pouring hot water over ground coffee in a glass server.
Alt: Saffron Signature Roast pouch on a wooden counter.

statement: Reading grade must not exceed the channel target (Instagram 8, email 10, website 10, LinkedIn 12).
source_quote: Match reading level to the channel: Instagram grade 8, email and website grade 10, LinkedIn grade 12.
examples_violating: An Instagram caption full of long, abstract, multi-clause sentences about provenance and extraction methodology.
A website paragraph with dense jargon and nested clauses.
examples_ok: Fresh beans, roasted this week. Come in for a cup.
We roast on Tuesdays and Fridays so every bag is fresh.

statement: Text on images must reach a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
source_quote: Text on images must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5 to 1.
examples_violating: Light grey text on a cream banner.
Saffron text on a white background.
examples_ok: Deep coffee brown text on cream.
Cream text on deep coffee brown.

statement: Each post carries one clear call to action (visit, order, subscribe).
source_quote: Each post carries one clear call to action, such as visit, order or subscribe.
examples_violating: Visit us, order online, subscribe, follow, share, and also tag a friend.
A caption with no next step at all.
examples_ok: Visit your nearest cafe this weekend.
Order the Diwali gift box online.

statement: Do not be too salesy.
source_quote: Do not be too salesy.
examples_violating: Buy now buy now buy now, best prices, order, order, order.
Discounts, discounts and more discounts.
examples_ok: Our monsoon roast is ready, and the cafe is warm.
A new lot from Chikmagalur, if you would like to try it.
